title: US ports are facing an escalating volume of cyber threats; the Port of LA logged 120M thwarted attempts in August alone, nearly double its 2023 monthly average (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: US ports are facing an escalating volume of cyber threats; the Port of LA logged 120M thwarted attempts in August alone, nearly double its 2023 monthly average — America's biggest crude oil export hub reports thousands of attempted hacks each day as shipping companies battle breaches
